name: product-strategy-pack
description: Claude Guide for Product Strategy: 32 Claude skills for one product strategy cycle in eight stages: diagnose with the strategic question, a product health read, an issue tree and a hypothesis board; read the market and the customer with competitors, segments by need, an opportunity solution tree and a market size; choose with options that differ in kind, a decision matrix, the bets and the not-doing list; stress-test with scenarios, a red team review and a pre-mortem; put numbers on it with a business case, a north star metric and strategy KPIs; build the Now-Next-Later roadmap and quarterly OKRs; tell it in the strategy document, the one page, the deck and the board memo; then review it each quarter. For product managers and product leaders who own a strategy or a roadmap, and founders and fractional product people who write one for a client. Claude structures the thinking and drafts the documents; a named person makes the choices, and every figure names its source or is marked as an assumption.
